engineering_duration_estimates.method: observed median/min/max H10+H5 pair rate plus observed model initialization per required fresh process; stratified engineering sizing, not confidence bounds

input_selection.nearest_rank_rule: round(q * (N - 1)); ties by earliest frozen corpus order

operational_feasibility.reason: observed sizing completed in two fresh processes and measured memory stayed below available device/host capacity

resources.capacity_assessment_rule: engineering preflight classification requires both observed peak fractions to remain below 0.90; this is not a scientific acceptance gate

timing_method: CUDA synchronize, monotonic wall timer, candidate inference, CUDA synchronize
